title: Cultural Heritage
description: Senior-high English unit on living heritage and contemporary guardianship; teaching materials generated bilingually.

discovery_answers.unit_theme: 文化遗产——活态传承与当代守护
discovery_answers.student_context: 高二学生，英语水平中上，能用英语进行基本讨论，需提升双语转换与深度表达能力
discovery_answers.teaching_objectives: 理解物质与非物质文化遗产的区别；掌握文化遗产主题双语词汇；能用中英双语介绍一项传统工艺并说明其当代价值
discovery_answers.material_positioning: 自编合成单元（主题语境对应人教版高中英语必修第二册 Unit 1 Cultural Heritage）

planning_answers.period_plan: 共6课时，每课2课时，评估聚焦双语工艺介绍与守护建议展示

expected_evidence_direction.criterion_notes: All seven intent fields are stated in the teacher-intent source; artifacts should mix Chinese and English teaching copy.
expected_evidence_direction.coverage_focus: Intangible-heritage concepts from the reading passage should appear across plans, decks, and exercises.
